facts.fact: ITWeb reports that South Africa's Promotion of Access to Information Act was the basis for an employee's February 2023 request to the Department of Public Service and Administration and for the Information Regulator's 16 November 2026 enforcement notice.
facts.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act

facts.fact: ITWeb reports that the Information Regulator, in an enforcement notice dated 16 November 2026, set aside the department's refusal of a PAIA request and ordered release of a legal opinion within 10 days.
facts.system: Promotion of Access to Information Act
